claims.text: Myfembree (relugolix + estradiol + norethindrone): HMB ← fibroids, premenopausal
claims.quote: MYFEMBREE is indicated for the management of heavy menstrual bleeding associated with uterine leiomyomas (fibroids) in premenopausal women [see Clinical Studies (14)].
claims.locator: MYFEMBREE (relugolix, estradiol, and norethindrone acetate) tablets prescribing information

claims.text: Oriahnn (elagolix + estradiol + norethindrone): HMB ← fibroids, premenopausal
claims.quote: ORIAHNN is indicated for the management of heavy menstrual bleeding associated with uterine leiomyomas (fibroids) in premenopausal women.
claims.locator: ORIAHNN (elagolix, estradiol, and norethindrone acetate capsules; elagolix capsules) prescribing information

claims.text: Myfembree: limit to 24 mo ← bone loss may be irreversible
claims.quote: Use of MYFEMBREE should be limited to 24 months due to the risk of continued bone loss which may not be reversible.
claims.locator: MYFEMBREE (relugolix, estradiol, and norethindrone acetate) tablets prescribing information
